live_regex.adapter_law: Source-faithful anchored numeric recognizer plus finite-number rejection and the common semantic observation wrapper.

deposed.adapter_law: Exact historical anchored regex with common extent/type/sign observation; no repair is credited to the peer.

c14.adapter_law: Exact C14 numericSource recognition with common extent/type/sign observation; CST allocation is excluded because the G10 feature result is a semantic leaf.

qualification_law: After candidate and revealed-holdout correctness, the benchmark runner must derive and emit each peer-specific case-ID intersection whose success/failure, extent, binary64 value, type, and sign observations match the candidate. Timing uses identical ordered cases, allocations, calls, observations, retained digest, build flags, and schedule. A win on an intersection is never semantic parity outside it.
performance_gate: Strict candidate win over live_regex, deposed, and c14 on every nonempty comparable intersection; no retry substitution, denominator borrowing, or correctness relaxation.
